description: The observatory on the ridge, where it is always night: the real sky right now from whichever observatory site on Earth is darkest, with the moon's phase, the planets that are up and the brightest stars. With "target" (the moon, a planet, or an object such as "pleiades", "orion-nebula" or "andromeda-galaxy"), look at it through the telescope. Nothing is stored.

target.description: Optional: what to look at. Without it, see the sky and what is up for the telescope.

name: look_through_the_telescope
title: Look through the telescope
